unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #2 (github.com/WebSoroban/x402-kit/issues/2): "A feeless settlement leg: no facilitator, no trustline, no network fee". Argued in the kit own terms from its README: managed facilitator (OpenZeppelin Channels) pays the network fee -> on Nano a signed send IS the settlement, no facilitator/channel/third-party fee, stranger re-derives the block from a public node; buyer holds a USDC trustline per issuer and a Stellar wallet ("Freighter Mobile cannot") -> Nano has no issuer/trustline, any Nano wallet including mobile pays directly; $0.01/request stays legible. Named a Nano leg under sd
